definitions.explanation: A sturdy table or surface used for performing manual work, crafting, cooking preparation, or other hands-on tasks.

examples.japanese: {作業台|さぎょうだい}の{上|うえ}に{道具|どうぐ}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: To line up tools on the workbench.

examples.japanese: キッチンの{作業台|さぎょうだい}で{野菜|やさい}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: To cut vegetables on the kitchen worktop.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}さを{調整|ちょうせい}できる{作業台|さぎょうだい}を{購入|こうにゅう}して、{作業|さぎょう}{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I bought a height-adjustable workbench, and my work efficiency improved.

notes:
Composed of {作業|さぎょう} (work, operation) and {台|だい} (stand, table, platform). Refers to any flat surface designed for performing work, from workshop benches to kitchen counters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業台|さぎょうだい}の{上|うえ}: on the workbench
- {作業台|さぎょうだい}を{設置|せっち}する: to set up a workbench
- ステンレス{製|せい}の{作業台|さぎょうだい}: stainless steel work table
- {折|お}りたたみ{作業台|さぎょうだい}: folding work table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ワークベンチ: workbench — the English loanword, used mainly in DIY contexts
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}: kitchen counter / prep station — specifically for cooking
- {工作台|こうさくだい}: craft table / workshop bench — specifically for crafting or machining
